results: 1. slit-lamp examination for Kayser-Fleischer rings: no rings
2. copper / caeruloplasmin / 24 h urinary copper: NORMAL - excludes Wilson disease
3. dystonia gene panel: biallelic GLB1 variants
4. lysosomal enzyme assay (beta-galactosidase, hexosaminidase): REDUCED beta-galactosidase, with 5-10% residual activity - type-III GM1 gangliosidosis
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Type III (chronic/adult) GM1 gangliosidosis, caused by biallelic pathogenic variants in the GLB1 gene resulting in deficient lysosomal beta-galactosidase activity (5-10% of normal).

Alternatives to consider:
1. Niemann-Pick disease type C (NPC1/NPC2) - treatable with miglustat; can mimic with dystonia/chorea
2. Neurodegeneration with brain iron accumulation (e.g., PKAN, PLA2G6-associated dystonia-parkinsonism)
3. Idiopathic/isolated dystonia (DYT-TOR1A, DYT-GCH1, etc.) - though the biallelic GLB1 findings make this very unlikely
dx: Type III (chronic/adult) GM1 gangliosidosis, caused by biallelic pathogenic variants in the GLB1 gene resulting in deficient lysosomal beta-galactosidase activity (5-10% of normal).
